facts.fact: The Ministry of Education and Sports states that it redeveloped the EMIS from 2019 under a memorandum with the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance, that MoES administrators run it, and that the old system had failed through donor dependence and abandonment by its software supplier.
The ministry's abstract reports pre-primary, primary and secondary schools responding to EMIS for the 2025 academic year: 7,408 pre-primary, 26,597 primary and 4,571 secondary.

The redeveloped EMIS collects individual learner-level data, issues a Learner Identification Number and tracks learner transfers, with heads of institutions as users; as of December 2025 the ministry counts 11,787,396 primary learners registered on it. The passages describe enrolment and transfer records and a 'data upload exercise', not attendance or results.

The Ministry of Education and Sports reports that 26,597 primary schools responded to the EMIS data upload for 2025, of 45,164 primary schools in the country (58.9%): 12,511 of 12,544 government schools and 14,086 of 32,620 private schools. The count is of schools that uploaded data, not of schools merely registered.

The ministry published its first annual statistical abstract since 2017, compiled from the redeveloped EMIS for the 2025 academic year; none could be produced for 2018 to 2024 after the annual school census was halted. No event date is given, so the publication date of January 2026 is used.

systems.platform: web-based; integrated with NIRA for identity verification and UNEB for index-number validation
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Sports, with the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance
systems.tiers: MoES administrators, local government officials (DEO/MEO/CEO/DIS/CAO), lower local government officers, heads of education institutions of all levels, the public; rolled out to all local governments in November 2022 and then to all institutions
hard-copy questionnaires to schools returning aggregated data; discontinued in 2017
verification of nationals' identification details for EMIS

note: Passages only. The table of government primary schools 'registered on EMIS' (12,544 in 2025) is a registration count and is not the figure used for the share.
